items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I used to transact all the business, you know, get jobs like that, transfer to Leo or McNeil. I would contact them and have them go check the guy who's never called, you see.

ctx.x: Morgan told me he was in the band and they had real trouble, Andrew Morgan, said he had a lot of trouble with the telephone then. Because the phone was in Elton Paredo's house, is that right? Yeah, that's what I'm talking about.

See, in other words, Kit Thomas was the real owner of the band. But Elton used to run the band, you see, so all the business was transacted through Elton. Yeah. Well that's the same way it was with the Sonny South. You see, I wasn't managing nothing, but I wasn't working, I wasn't doing nothing, playing music, and other guys was working, and so I used to transact all the business, you know, get jobs like that, transfer to Leo or McNeil.
